mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of months where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the average return in such months is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based recovery in household demand, which boosts corporate sales and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 108.0 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and reduces corporate profitability expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108.0 for two months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum, combined with a sustained increase in CPI inflation, signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% combined with a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k signals a labor market that is overheating, increasing the risk of wage-driven inflation and prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which pressures equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 200.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 200.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 520,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in housing starts below 1.2 million units, signals a weakening in household demand and confidence, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances where both RSAFS < 520000 and HOUST < 1200.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 108.0, combined with a decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, signals a manufacturing and output contraction that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 108.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0 (annualized) in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances where both INDPRO < 108.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0 (annualized), or the joint signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
